hints.title: Bitmask Formulation
hints.text: Represent each string as a 26-bit bitmask since characters are distinct and order does not matter.

hints.title: Connected Transitions
hints.text: Two masks are connected if they differ by 1 bit (addition/deletion) or 2 bits with opposite parity (replacement).

hints.title: Connect via Deleted Sub-Masks
hints.text: For each mask, deleting any bit yields an intermediate state. Connect masks that share the same deleted sub-mask to capture replacements in one step.

hints.title: Complete Python Solution

complexity.time: O(N) single pass or optimal algorithmic traversal
variables: N: input size or row count
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Pairwise Hamming distance checks take O(N^2 * 26) time, which times out for N = 20,000.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Sub-mask hashing with Disjoint Set Union runs in O(N * 26 * alpha(N)) time and O(N * 26) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Model string edits as bitmask transitions and connect via intermediate deletion states.
